feeding_claim.verbatim: Instead, our cattle graze on pastures, enjoying a diet primarily composed of hay forages supplemented with a small amount of feed.

farmers_markets: Middletown Farmers Market, behind the Appoquinimink Library (Saturday, May to October)

resold_note: Also sells cheese, yogurt, butter and ice cream from other local farms and creameries, plus honey, maple syrup, produce and seafood it does not raise.
notes: Feed supplement for cattle is farm-grown corn, soybean meal and minerals, so category set to percentage; pigs and chickens are fed farm-grown corn rations and the site does not say they are on pasture, though the Meet Us page calls the meat pasture-raised. Home delivery is offered only on specific days to unnamed local areas, so no areas recorded. Bulk freezer beef in 1/8, 1/4, 1/2 and whole. Homepage mentions occasional lamb and the Meet Us page mentions turkeys; not listed as species. No shipping mentioned. Grocery and restaurant outlets are not named.
